title: Wise Sans / typeface film

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Explain the sources of a typeface’s character because letterforms can carry a cultural point of view as well as words.
strategic_value: Script references and distinctive heavy forms can make Wise’s global positioning visible in its typography.
demonstration: The film introduces Wise Sans, connects it to photographed scripts, enlarges letter details, shows an uppercase alphabet and cycles short currency-related letter groups.
practical_value: Compare a typeface’s stated inspiration with observable terminals, diagonals and dense headline setting.
